workstreams.state: remember-login source implemented; migration and live verification pending
workstreams.summary: The landing offers an unchecked remember option. Ordinary sessions expire after 30 minutes idle; new opted-in sessions have no fixed server deadline and renew their browser cookie after a successful account check. Older opted-in sessions retain their 30-day limit; browsers can still delete or limit cookies. Existing account databases need an explicit migration before rollout. Public host is www.citedtrip.app; live Auth0 and deployed flows remain unverified.

The Mac poller tracks main with its local deployment gate enabled, and waits for a successful push CI run before app-only deployment.
